video_title: Toronto Raptors Full Media Availability | Pre Season vs New York Knicks | October 13, 2026

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković on integrating Kawhi Leonard into the Raptors' system
quotes.excerpt: It was great that he had chance to play with our starters that everybody was available tonight.
quotes.quote: It was great. First game for him. It was great that he had chance to play with our starters that everybody was available tonight. I tried to get those guys as much as possible on the court together so that they figure out the chemistry and spacing and that kind of stuff. Obviously just the first game. He was very excited coming into this game and I thought he did great.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic says Kawhi Leonard brings gravity to the Raptors offense, noting that when he is on the floor he opens up a lot of space for Scottie Barnes, Immanuel Quickley, and RJ Barrett.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković on Kawhi Leonard's spacing impact on teammates
quotes.excerpt: When Kawhi is on the floor, he attracts so much gravity and opens up a lot of space.
quotes.quote: When you have our starters out there, when you have the way Jakob is shooting now, I have huge trust in Allen and his three-point shooting. Colin worked so hard over the course of the summer on his shooting. We need more guys that can be willing to take shots and to knock down shots for us. But when Kawhi is on the floor, he attracts so much gravity and opens up a lot of space for Scottie and Quick and RJ and for everybody else. So they really complement each other well.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic on the Raptors offensive spacing: When Kawhi Leonard is on the floor he attracts so much gravity and opens up a lot of space for Scottie, Quick, and RJ.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković on defensive accountability and rotation
quotes.excerpt: We want to be super aggressive on the ball and if any breakdown happens, you got to know.
quotes.quote: We are trying to be aggressive and really to cover for each other. We want to be super aggressive on the ball and if any breakdown happens, you got to know you got four people behind you ready to rotate and help for you. So we are constantly encouraging guys to do that.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic says the Raptors are emphasizing defensive accountability, telling players that if a breakdown happens they have to know they have four people behind them ready to rotate and help.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković on Raptors' improved three-point shooting volume
quotes.excerpt: We did not force any of those shots. I think they were great looks.
quotes.quote: I think we did not force any of those shots. I think they were great looks with Kawhi's ability to create his own shot off the dribble and pick and rolls as well as IQ. RJ is a sniper when his feet are set and when he is in good spacing. Quick, Scottie is shooting the ball very confidently. We have multiple guys that are very, very capable and we are encouraging them and they have good shots to take those shots.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic is encouraging the Raptors to increase their three-point volume, noting that RJ Barrett is a sniper when his feet are set and Scottie Barnes is shooting the ball very confidently.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković evaluates Kawhi Leonard's debut performance
quotes.excerpt: He was aggressive, he was willing to take open shots.
quotes.quote: I think he was great. He was aggressive, he was willing to take open shots. I want him to take all open looks that he is getting. I want him to be always cutting and always on the move to go and crash. I thought that he had a great game and it was great that he was aggressive on defensive and I actually loved all the fouls that he picked up tonight.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic was pleased with Kawhi Leonard's debut, saying he was aggressive and that he actually loved all the fouls that he picked up tonight.

quotes.speaker: Kawhi Leonard
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard on his Raptors debut and learning the system
quotes.excerpt: Just being able to get out there and play a different opponent was great.
quotes.quote: Feels good. Just being able to get out there and play a different opponent was great. The crowd involved and the fatigue, coach calling plays and learning on the fly, it is all great practice.
quotes.social_post: Kawhi Leonard on his Raptors debut: It feels good to get out there and play a different opponent. Coach is calling plays and I am learning on the fly, it is all great practice.

quotes.speaker: Kawhi Leonard
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard emphasizes defensive mindset in Raptors debut
quotes.excerpt: We came in and looked like focused on defense and that was my intentions.
quotes.quote: We came in and looked like focused on defense and that was my intentions and wanted to just get out there and get tired. Still want to get in better shape and yeah, it was fun to play.
quotes.social_post: Kawhi Leonard says his focus in his Raptors debut was on defense and getting in better shape: We came in and looked focused on defense and that was my intention.

quotes.speaker: Kawhi Leonard
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard on team-first basketball and defensive identity
quotes.excerpt: It is all about defense and mindset first and sharing the basketball.
quotes.quote: It is all about defense and mindset first and sharing the basketball. That is how I like to play. That is how I grew to play in the NBA, a team game and just everybody really being involved on any given night. It is always difficult just learning the different schemes and him telling me certain things to do, but at the end of our conversation, he always just tells me, just go play basketball.
quotes.social_post: Kawhi Leonard on his transition to the Raptors: It is all about defense and mindset first and sharing the basketball. That is how I like to play.

quotes.speaker: Kawhi Leonard
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard on his role and team-first mentality
quotes.excerpt: Running for others first and then yourself.
quotes.quote: Whatever is needed from me, if I am above the ball and I am able to sprint corner and if the shot doesn't come to me, just giving anybody a lane to drive to the basket. That is how I learned to play the game in the NBA, running for others first and then yourself. I am just here to fit in like I said, but fit out a little bit just by trying to play great basketball and just being aggressive.
quotes.social_post: Kawhi Leonard on his role in Toronto: Whatever is needed from me, I am just here to fit in but fit out a little bit just by trying to play great basketball and being aggressive.
